prompt: I'm not sure about the cafe's hours. ___ the kitchen is closed, we'll eat at home.
explanation_ru: Говорящий не уверен, закрыта ли кухня, поэтому событие лишь возможное — нужен союз if. Союз when используют для уверенных событий, а unless меняет смысл на противоположный.
answer: If

prompt: Heavy rain is falling on our football pitch in Inverness. Our coach says we will cancel the match if the grass {{1:to stay}} too wet. We don't have a roof over the pitch. If we {{2:to have}} one, the grass {{3:not / to get}} so wet.
explanation_ru: Первое условие реальное (First Conditional), поэтому после if нужен Present Simple — stays. Во второй части ситуация воображаемая, так как крыши нет (Second Conditional): Past Simple (had) и wouldn't get.
answer_text: Heavy rain is falling on our football pitch in Inverness. Our coach says we will cancel the match if the grass stays too wet. We don't have a roof over the pitch. If we had one, the grass wouldn't get so wet.

prompt: Classify these sentences from Saeed's newsroom in Coimbra: Zero, First, or Second conditional?
explanation_ru: Zero Conditional (Present Simple + Present Simple) описывает регулярные привычки офиса. First Conditional (Present Simple + will) — реальные планы и предупреждения. Second Conditional (Past Simple + would) — воображаемые ситуации в настоящем.
sort_items: When the morning meeting approaches, the office coffee machine always runs out of milk.
Whenever nobody refills the fridge, the editors drink black coffee.
If Saeed stops by the corner shop on his way in, he will bring two cartons.
Unless someone buys milk before nine, the interns will complain again.
If the newsroom had a bigger budget, we would order milk deliveries.
Saeed wouldn't look so grumpy if he had his usual latte.
answer_text: When the morning meeting approaches, the office coffee machine always runs out of milk. → Zero conditional · Whenever nobody refills the fridge, the editors drink black coffee. → Zero conditional · If Saeed stops by the corner shop on his way in, he will bring two cartons. → First conditional · Unless someone buys milk before nine, the interns will complain again. → First conditional · If the newsroom had a bigger budget, we would order milk deliveries. → Second conditional · Saeed wouldn't look so grumpy if he had his usual latte. → Second conditional

prompt: Neda is making a concrete deal with her cafe manager in Santander about the coming term. Which sentence states her real offer correctly?
explanation_ru: Это реальная договорённость на будущее, поэтому нужен First Conditional: will work в главной части и Present Simple (give) после if. Вариант с will после if — частая ошибка, а Second Conditional сделал бы предложение маловероятным.
options: I would work the holidays if you gave me the early shift all term.
I will work the holidays if you will give me the early shift all term.
I will work the holidays when you will give me the early shift all term.
I will work the holidays if you give me the early shift all term.
answer: I will work the holidays if you give me the early shift all term.

prompt: If Isha had bought a loaf before her late shift started, she wouldn't have gone home empty-handed.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Third Conditional описывает нереальное прошлое с противоположным смыслом: «если бы купила, не ушла бы с пустыми руками» означает, что в реальности она не купила хлеб и ушла домой с пустыми руками.
options: Isha bought a loaf before her shift and went home empty-handed.
Isha didn't buy a loaf before her shift and went home empty-handed.
Isha didn't buy a loaf before her shift, so she still has bread at home.
Isha never buys bread before her late shift, so she always goes home without it.
answer: Isha didn't buy a loaf before her shift and went home empty-handed.

prompt: Astrid bakes country loaves in her farm kitchen in Burgundy. Her dough always {{1:to rise}} faster when the morning air is warm and damp. On Tuesday a cold breeze blew through the open window, so the batch came out flat. If she {{2:to close}} the window in time, the bread would have turned out soft. Astrid wishes the old kitchen {{3:to have}} better heating for winter baking.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — постоянный факт (Zero Conditional: rises). Второй описывает нереальное прошлое во вторник (Third Conditional: had closed). В последнем после wish о настоящем ставится Past Simple (had).
answer_text: Astrid bakes country loaves in her farm kitchen in Burgundy. Her dough always rises faster when the morning air is warm and damp. On Tuesday a cold breeze blew through the open window, so the batch came out flat. If she had closed the window in time, the bread would have turned out soft. Astrid wishes the old kitchen had better heating for winter baking.

prompt: Decide which time and world each sentence from Varun's hotel in Sharjah describes.
explanation_ru: Реальные правила и планы выражены через Present Simple и will. Нереальное настоящее — через Past Simple (worked, didn't have) и would + инфинитив. Нереальное прошлое — через Past Perfect (had arrived, had booked) и would have + V3.
sort_items: When checkout begins, the cleaners always start on the top floor.
If the guests in Room 504 leave early, we will prepare their suite first.
If the lift worked faster, the staff would finish the top floor in half an hour.
Varun wishes he didn't have to answer three phones at once.
If the tour bus had arrived on schedule, the lobby wouldn't have been so crowded.
We would have offered you a sea-view room if you had booked a week earlier.
answer_text: When checkout begins, the cleaners always start on the top floor. → Real present / future · If the guests in Room 504 leave early, we will prepare their suite first. → Real present / future · If the lift worked faster, the staff would finish the top floor in half an hour. → Unreal present · Varun wishes he didn't have to answer three phones at once. → Unreal present · If the tour bus had arrived on schedule, the lobby wouldn't have been so crowded. → Unreal past · We would have offered you a sea-view room if you had booked a week earlier. → Unreal past

prompt: It is Wednesday morning at the dental clinic in Vigo. The dentist sees only emergency patients on Wednesdays, and your tooth feels completely fine.
explanation_ru: Сейчас среда, но экстренной ситуации у вас нет — это воображаемое условие в настоящем (Second Conditional): Past Simple после if (had) и would в главной части. После if нельзя ставить would, а when и Third Conditional здесь не подходят.
options: If I would have an emergency, the dentist would see me today.
When I have an emergency, the dentist will see me today.
If I had an emergency, the dentist would see me today.
If I had had an emergency, the dentist would have seen me today.
answer: If I had an emergency, the dentist would see me today.

answer: Jovan says the shared drive locks at six; if it stayed open longer, we could finish comfortably.
accepted_answers: Jovan says the shared drive locks at six; if it stayed open longer, we could finish comfortably.

prompt: We met a park ranger on a steep path in the Julian Alps. "These rocks always {{1:to freeze}} quickly when the sun drops," he warned. "If you {{2:to keep}} climbing after dark, you will slip on the ice." We took his advice and turned back straight away. If we {{3:not / to listen}} to him, we would have been stuck on the cold slope.
explanation_ru: Первый пропуск — регулярное природное явление (Zero Conditional: freeze). Второй — реальное предупреждение о будущем после if (First Conditional: keep, без will). Третий — нереальное прошлое (Third Conditional: hadn't listened).
answer_text: We met a park ranger on a steep path in the Julian Alps. "These rocks always freeze quickly when the sun drops," he warned. "If you keep climbing after dark, you will slip on the ice." We took his advice and turned back straight away. If we hadn't listened to him, we would have been stuck on the cold slope.

prompt: Nobody follows the kitchen memo in our Aarhus office. What ___ if the manager locked the kettle away?
explanation_ru: В условии стоит Past Simple (locked) — это воображаемая ситуация в настоящем (Second Conditional), поэтому в вопросе нужен глагол would happen.
answer: would happen

prompt: If Nicole hadn't accepted the steady post at the Budapest music academy years ago, she wouldn't still be teaching first-year students now.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Это смешанное условие (Mixed Conditional): прошлое условие (hadn't accepted) и результат в настоящем (wouldn't still be teaching). В реальности полярность обратная: она приняла должность и до сих пор преподаёт первокурсникам.
options: Nicole turned down the steady post years ago and no longer teaches first-year students.
Nicole accepted the steady post years ago, so she stopped teaching first-year students.
Nicole accepted the steady post years ago, and she still teaches first-year students.
Nicole didn't accept the steady post years ago, yet she still teaches first-year students.
answer: Nicole accepted the steady post years ago, and she still teaches first-year students.

prompt: Eoghan turned down a noisy city job five years ago and chose to drive the coastal airport shuttle in Costa Rica instead. If he {{1:to take}} that stressful office job, he {{2:not / to be}} nearly as calm and happy now. Whenever a flight {{3:to land}} late at night, he waits patiently outside arrivals with a flask of coffee. His friends in the capital often say they wish they {{4:to make}} the same bold move when they had the chance.
explanation_ru: Первые два пропуска образуют Mixed Conditional (нереальное прошлое решение → результат сейчас: had taken, wouldn't be). В третьем — регулярная привычка после whenever (lands). В четвёртом — сожаление о прошлом после wish (Past Perfect: had made).
answer_text: Eoghan turned down a noisy city job five years ago and chose to drive the coastal airport shuttle in Costa Rica instead. If he had taken that stressful office job, he wouldn't be nearly as calm and happy now. Whenever a flight lands late at night, he waits patiently outside arrivals with a flask of coffee. His friends in the capital often say they wish they had made the same bold move when they had the chance.

prompt: Joao's old flat in the northern city wouldn't be standing empty now if he hadn't moved to sunny Cascais for the weather.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Смешанное условие (wouldn't be standing empty now + if he hadn't moved) означает, что в реальности Жуан переехал в Кашкайш, и поэтому его старая квартира сейчас пустует.
options: Joao moved to Cascais, so his old flat in the northern city stands empty now.
Joao didn't move to Cascais, so his old flat in the northern city stands empty now.
Joao moved to Cascais, and someone else is living in his old flat now.
Joao wants to move to Cascais, so he left his old flat empty.
answer: Joao moved to Cascais, so his old flat in the northern city stands empty now.

prompt: Edward worked part-time while studying in Basel, so today he holds a university degree and has healthy savings in the bank. Which sentence correctly imagines the opposite?
explanation_ru: Решение относится к прошлому (нужен Past Perfect: hadn't studied), а результат — к настоящему (now → wouldn't have, без have + V3). Это Mixed Conditional; остальные варианты содержат ошибки во времени или лишний would после if.
options: If Edward hadn't studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have had both a degree and savings now.
If Edward didn't study part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.
If Edward wouldn't have studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.
If Edward hadn't studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.
answer: If Edward hadn't studied part-time in Basel, he wouldn't have both a degree and savings now.

prompt: The new technician in Mallow is usually careless about warnings. Yesterday he switched off the backup server mid-update, and the whole system crashed.
explanation_ru: Постоянная черта в настоящем (он невнимателен вообще → Second Conditional: If he were more careful) повлияла на событие в прошлом (вчера он отключил сервер → Third Conditional: wouldn't have switched off).
options: If the technician were more careful, he wouldn't have switched off the backup server during the update.
If the technician were more careful, he wouldn't switch off the backup server during yesterday's update.
If the technician had been more careful, he wouldn't switch off the backup server yesterday.
If the technician would be more careful, he wouldn't have switched off the backup server during the update.

prompt: Group these sentences from the Snowdonia campsite guide by their conditional logic.
explanation_ru: В группе Real condition — реальные правила и возможные события (Present Simple, will). В Unreal (single time) обе части относятся к одному времени (чистый 2-й или 3-й тип). В Mixed (two times) условие и результат лежат в разных временах.
sort_items: The night walk will go ahead only if the wind drops below the safe limit.
When thick mist rolls over the valley, we always cancel the ridge trail.
If the campers had brought spare batteries, their torches wouldn't have died on the hill.
If I were leading a group of beginners tonight, I would choose the lower lakeside path.
If the guide weren't so cautious by nature, he would have let the group climb in last night's storm.
If we had cancelled the walk an hour earlier, everyone wouldn't still be drying their boots now.
answer_text: The night walk will go ahead only if the wind drops below the safe limit. → Real condition · When thick mist rolls over the valley, we always cancel the ridge trail. → Real condition · If the campers had brought spare batteries, their torches wouldn't have died on the hill. → Unreal (single time) · If I were leading a group of beginners tonight, I would choose the lower lakeside path. → Unreal (single time) · If the guide weren't so cautious by nature, he would have let the group climb in last night's storm. → Mixed (two times) · If we had cancelled the walk an hour earlier, everyone wouldn't still be drying their boots now. → Mixed (two times)

prompt: In the campus office in Manama, the printer room always {{1:to run}} out of paper right before exam week. answer_text: In the campus office in Manama, the printer room always runs out of paper right before exam week. prompt: Odile is leaving for a week. She writes a note for her neighbour: Thank you for helping! If the weather {{1:to be}} hot, {{2:to water}} the plants twice a day. If a parcel {{3:to arrive}} for me, {{4:to keep}} it at your flat. I will be back next Sunday.
explanation_ru: После if о возможном будущем нужен Present Simple (is, arrives), а просьбы в главной части — повелительное наклонение (water, keep).
answer_text: Odile is leaving for a week. She writes a note for her neighbour: Thank you for helping! If the weather is hot, water the plants twice a day. If a parcel arrives for me, keep it at your flat. I will be back next Sunday.
